grants_phd_evidence.quote: Penn's graduate groups are organized specifically to provide PhD training, independent of academic departments.

programs.program_name: Genomics and Computational Biology (GCB) Graduate Group
programs.phd_evidence_quote: Thank you for your interest in the University of Pennsylvania’s doctoral program in Genomics and Computational Biology (GCB).
programs.notes: Evidence quote from https://www.med.upenn.edu/gcb/admission/. Two PhD tracks listed on the site: Genomics and Algorithms Track; Biomedical Informatics Track. Applications are submitted through BGS.

programs.program_name: Biostatistics PhD (Epidemiology and Biostatistics Graduate Group, GGEB)
programs.phd_evidence_quote: Students are admitted into the MS and PhD degree programs in Biostatistics for the fall term only.
programs.notes: GGEB is one of the seven BGS graduate groups (https://www.med.upenn.edu/bgs/graduate-group-list.html); GGEB home https://www.med.upenn.edu/ggeb/.

programs.program_name: Epidemiology PhD (Epidemiology and Biostatistics Graduate Group, GGEB)
programs.phd_evidence_quote: is responsible for developing and administering the PhD degree programs in epidemiology and biostatistics as well as the MS program in biostatistics.
programs.notes: Included because several direction-A authors (genetic epidemiology) are listed as its faculty.

programs.program_name: Cell and Molecular Biology (CAMB) Graduate Group - Genetics and Epigenetics (G&E) program
programs.umbrella_name: Biomedical Graduate Studies (BGS) / Cell and Molecular Biology (CAMB)
programs.phd_evidence_quote: Upon completion of the PhD, they pursue successful research careers at top academic institutions, in the biotech and pharmaceutical industries, and in other biomedicine-related career paths.
programs.notes: G&E faculty page matched 12; the Cell Biology (cb-faculty) program page additionally matched Kathrin Maria Bernt and Michael A. Lampson (Lampson, Bernt, Tan, Shi are on the cell biology list).

programs.program_name: Biochemistry, Biophysics, Chemical Biology (BBCB) Graduate Group
programs.phd_evidence_quote: The faculty are passionate about Biochemistry, Biophysics and Chemical Biology, as well as passionate about sharing their knowledge with the next generation of PhDs and PhD/MDs.
programs.notes: Old URL https://www.med.upenn.edu/bmbgrad/ redirects here. https://www.med.upenn.edu/bmbgrad/bbcb_faculty.html matched 0 (stale list).
